records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Next step after your onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Great chatting on the onboarding call last week. You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing 
inside Wrenfield -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

One thing that usually helps next: bringing in a teammate. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk you through that next step this week? Happy to help however is easiest -- just reply and I'll follow up.

Best,
Priya
